title: Open Mic @ Burns Alley Tavern
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring local musicians and performers in an intimate dive bar setting. This event welcomes all genres and skill levels in a supportive atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Burns Alley Tavern

Burns Alley Tavern is a vibrant dive bar nestled in downtown Charleston behind the Yeti store off King Street. This welcoming establishment features live music nearly every night showcasing diverse genres from soulful R&B to hard rock.

Musical Events

The venue hosts karaoke nights and regular open mic events highlighting the tavern's commitment to fostering a lively community vibe. With bartenders known for friendly service and affordable drinks including PBRs and craft beers guests enjoy an authentic Charleston nightlife experience.

Venue Features

The spacious two-floor layout provides ample seating and maintains a lively atmosphere. Located near College of Charleston the tavern is a popular hangout for students and locals seeking casual entertainment. Tuesday nights feature free live shows with Pork Chop while Wednesday brings karaoke with DJ Wild Bill.

title: Open Mic @ The Purple Buffalo
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring poetry comedy and live music in Charleston's premier alternative event space. Artists across all genres are welcome to perform.
event_venue_information:
About The Purple Buffalo

The Purple Buffalo stands as a vibrant hub for music enthusiasts distinguished by its eclectic atmosphere and diverse entertainment offerings. With a spacious lounge area and inviting outdoor patio this venue fosters a relaxed environment for enjoying live music.

Music and Events

The venue features carefully curated drinks including well-mixed cocktails and affordable beer. The Purple Buffalo showcases local talent hosting jazz nights open mic sessions poetry events and burlesque shows. The venue boasts impressive acoustics tailored for musicians with continuous enhancements for exceptional sound experiences.

Atmosphere

Regularly featuring talented local artists across genres from hip-hop to jazz The Purple Buffalo also offers affordable drink prices and tasty menu offerings. Notable themed nights include karaoke and weekly open mic sessions making this a welcoming space that guarantees memorable nights in Charleston's alternative music scene.

title: Bluegrass Brunch @ Prohibition
event_description: Sunday bluegrass brunch featuring New Ghost Town performing traditional bluegrass standards and contemporary hits in bluegrass style while guests enjoy Southern-inspired cuisine.
event_venue_information:
About Prohibition

Prohibition is a jazz-age inspired restaurant and bar located in beautiful downtown Charleston offering Southern-inspired cuisine and award-winning cocktails. The venue features live music and DJs regularly creating an energetic atmosphere.

Music Programming

The venue hosts bluegrass brunch every Sunday from 11am-2pm featuring New Ghost Town fronted by Daniel Patrick on mandolin and vocals. The band plays traditional bluegrass standards and bluegrass-styled versions of songs from the 70s through today. Saturday brunch features soulful singer-songwriter Krystal Halvorson from 11am-2pm with unique takes on classics from the 50s to today.

Dining Experience

Prohibition serves brunch Thursday through Sunday and dinner nightly. The menu features locally-sourced Southern-inspired dishes. The venue includes a main dining room seating 70 guests and beautiful climate-controlled outdoor patio spaces. With live jazz swing and big band music plus weekend DJs the venue maintains a lively speakeasy atmosphere perfect for dining and dancing.

title: Live Music @ Charleston Pour House
event_description: Seven nights a week live music venue featuring two stages with touring and local acts across jam rock funk bluegrass indie and reggae genres.
event_venue_information:
About Charleston Pour House

Charleston Pour House is a home-grown independently operated music venue established in 2002 featuring two stages and live music seven nights a week. The venue has a capacity of 500 people and is known as PoHo by locals.

Musical Programming

The venue features an indoor Main Stage and outdoor Deck Stage offering flexible spaces for jam funk bluegrass indie rock reggae and electronic music. Notable weekly events include Dead Wednesday since 2010 celebrating Grateful Dead music. The Pour House hosts Sunday Brunch Farmers Market that transforms the grounds into a daytime community hub.

Venue Atmosphere

With intimate capacity crisp sound and clear sightlines the venue is built for dancing and discovering new bands. The come-as-you-are vibe extends to patio hangouts and rotating taps. Most shows are general admission so early arrival is recommended. The location on James Island is a quick drive from downtown Charleston with convenient parking.

title: Live Music @ The Royal American
event_description: Neighborhood bar restaurant and intimate concert venue featuring local regional and national artists performing original music across indie rock alt-country and Americana genres.
event_venue_information:
About The Royal American

Located in the Ole Charleston Forge building on Charleston's Upper Peninsula The Royal American has been serving quality food drink and live music since 2011. The venue is part neighborhood bar part listening room delivering intimate grit-and-glow atmosphere.

Music Scene

The calendar leans eclectic with indie rock alt-country punk hip-hop and Americana sharing the bill across weeknights and weekend shows. Emerging national tours mix with Charleston standouts. The cozy stage features professional lighting and sound with a crowd focused on discovery as much as headliners.

Food and Atmosphere

Executive Chef Kirsten Lawton has elevated the Classic American menu with rotating soups Red Plate Specials and Staff Meals. Royal menu classics include 32oz Punches Housemade Beef Jerky Signature Hamburgers Patty Melts and Colossal Baked Potatoes. The venue hosts weekend markets including Thrifters and Drifters featuring vintage and locally curated art. The room is compact with crisp sound and friendly sightlines making shows feel personal and unfiltered.
